record.edic_text:
1316 diachorizomai {dee-akh-o-rid'-zom-ahee}

from 1223 and the middle voice of 5563;; v

AV - depart 1; 1

1) to separate thoroughly or wholly
2) to separate one's self, depart

same.cexp: 分開；＜被＞離開，分開（離婚）；被帶走
＜所＞沒有，不藉著，跟…無關；＜副＞分開地
